antigravity.router.baseUrl.description: 9 Router base URL (OpenAI-compatible). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1

antigravity.router.apiKey.description: Optional API key for the 9 Router. Leave empty if auth is disabled.

antigravity.models.filterLive.description: Hide live/voice conversation (voice-to-voice) models from the model picker. Turn off to browse and select them.

antigravity.session.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat replies (0 = strict, 1 = creative).

antigravity.session.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may produce per reply.

antigravity.session.systemPrompt.description: Extra system instructions prepended to the agent rules.

antigravity.session.allowShell.description: Allow the agent to run shell commands.

antigravity.session.allowVscode.description: Allow the agent to run VS Code commands.

antigravity.session.allowFiles.description: Allow the agent to read, list, open and write files.

antigravity.session.allowWeb.description: Allow the agent to search the web and fetch public URLs/documentation.

antigravity.session.maxTurns.description: Conversation history length (messages beyond this get trimmed).

antigravity.session.resumeOnOpen.description: Automatically resume the previous conversation where you closed the chat in both text and voice mode.

antigravity.session.persistHistory.description: Persist chat messages, tool outputs, and voice turns across editor and chat window closes.

antigravity.session.unifiedVoiceAndText.description: Synchronize conversation context bidirectionally between Voice Mode and Text Mode.

antigravity.session.maxPersistedTurns.description: Maximum conversation turns persisted per session.

antigravity.voice.liveModel.description: Model for Live sessions (BidiGenerateContent). Only models that support live voice-to-voice and simultaneous real-time text are compatible.

antigravity.voice.geminiApiKeys.description: Comma-separated Gemini API key(s) for Voice Mode. Multiple keys provide automatic fallback if a key reaches its quota limit or encounters an error.

antigravity.voice.inputDevice.description: Microphone name(s) for sox, e.g. "Microphone Array", or a JSON array of preferred names in order: ["Microphone Array","Microphone (Realtek Audio)"]. Empty or "#auto" (default) = auto-detect the real mic on any machine (never picks a Stereo Mix/loopback). Use "Voice: List audio devices" to see the exact names this PC exposes.

antigravity.voice.echoCancellation.description: Acoustic echo cancellation (AEC3, the same algorithm browsers use, running in-process as WASM). Cancels the AI's own voice picked up by the mic before it reaches Gemini — removes the 'AI repeats its own last words' problem. Disable to send raw mic audio exactly like the legacy build.

antigravity.voice.echoDelayMs.description: Render-to-capture echo-path latency the AEC must compensate for (ms). The AI's voice takes time to leave the speakers and reach the mic; telling the AEC this delay lets it subtract the echo instead of gating your voice. 100-200 is the typical working range; if echo returns, raise it; if your voice is muted while the AI talks (and you're NOT interrupting), lower it.

antigravity.voice.ttsVoice.description: Voice name for Gemini Live replies (e.g. Kore, Puck, Charon, Aoede).

antigravity.voice.soxPath.description: Path to sox.exe for mic capture. Leave empty to auto-detect.

antigravity.voice.ffplayPath.description: Path to ffplay.exe for audio playback. Leave empty to auto-detect.

antigravity.voice.bargeIn.description: Allow interrupting the AI by speaking aloud while it is talking (voice barge-in). Disabled by default (Half-Duplex safe mode) to prevent speaker audio leakage from cutting off the AI in the middle of replies on laptop speakers. When disabled, the AI speaks completely uninterrupted, and you can interrupt anytime via the 'Interrupt AI' button or command.

antigravity.voice.bargeInThreshold.description: RMS volume threshold for voice barge-in (0.05 to 0.50). Higher values require speaking louder to interrupt and prevent accidental cutoffs from background sounds or speaker echo.
